naturalLanguageQuery: who are the technical delivery managers and what controls are they responsible for
generatedSQL:
SELECT DISTINCT
  tdm.name AS "Technical Delivery Manager",
  c.control_name AS "Control Name"
FROM 
  TechnicalDeliveryManagers tdm
JOIN 
  Controls c ON tdm.delivery_manager_id = c.manager_id;
